item.title: T-Mat Global Now Serving US, UAE & UK Markets
item.description: T-Mat Global is now actively serving clients across the USA, UAE, and UK with offshore software development, cloud engineering, DevOps, and AI infrastructure services. Operating in US time zones from India for seamless real-time collaboration.

item.title: T-Mat Global Officially Recognized by DPIIT — Startup India Initiative
item.description: T-Mat Global Technologies Private Limited has been officially recognized by the Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT) under the Startup India Initiative, Government of India.

item.title: T-Mat Global Website Launched
